NightShift is a free music studio for Windows and Mac: patterns and a step sequencer, a piano roll, a mixer, built-in synths and drum kits, and an AI band (drummer, bass, guitar, keys and synth) that writes parts in the style you describe.

## What's new in 0.4.2

- **Check for updates.** In the ⋯ menu: NightShift asks GitHub whether there's a newer version and, if there is, installs it for you. It downloads the installer, checks it's the genuine file, then NightShift closes and the update goes in (on Windows it opens again by itself; on a Mac, follow the installer's steps). It only looks when you ask, so after this one you won't need this page to update.
- **NightShift's website has moved** to [exfilbravo.github.io/nightshift](https://exfilbravo.github.io/nightshift/).

## New in 0.4.0 and 0.4.1

- **Give the AI band a song for its vibe.** In the AI tab's Song panel, click **Listen to a song...** (or drop an MP3, WAV, AIFF, FLAC or Ogg file on it). In a few seconds the band hears its tempo, beat, key, chords, sections and sound, then writes a new song of its own with that vibe. You choose how close it stays: Close, Some changes or Loosely. It all happens on your computer and nothing is sent anywhere.
- **The 808 and 909 in Nightshift Drums.** Two new kits, each drawn as its drum machine: click a drum to play it, and the step lamps follow the beat. They're built in, so there's nothing to download.
- **Clicking a drum plays it straight away.** In NightShift, clicking a drum in Nightshift Drums (or a key on a synth's own keyboard) now plays at once, even before you've pressed Play.
- **Write a song with this vibe is always in sight.** When the bottom panel is short, as it is when NightShift opens, the button now sits beside what the band heard instead of below the panel's edge, with Play it as and How close on one row under it.
- **The new-plugins note shows once.** NightShift no longer says it found the same plugins every time it starts. It happened with plugins such as Surge XT, CHOWTapeModel and TAL-Chorus-LX, and with any plugin that had been updated.

0.3.0 gave the AI drummer a real drummer's feel, learned from the Groove MIDI Dataset, and stopped file names you type in Save as from playing notes. 0.2.0 brought 13 new styles the AI band plays as its own (house, techno, EDM, drum and bass, dubstep, synthwave, reggae, reggaeton, afrobeats, bossa nova, ambient, cinematic and country), soft verses that stay soft on the built-in sounds, and a Donate button. NightShift is free and always will be; donating is entirely up to you.

## Install

**Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit):** download `NightShift-Setup-….exe` below and run it. It installs just for you, with no admin password. The setup isn't signed (signing costs money), so Windows may say "Windows protected your PC": click **More info**, then **Run anyway**.

**Mac with Apple Silicon (M1 or newer, macOS 11 or later):** download `NightShift-…-mac.pkg` below and double-click it. It isn't signed by Apple (that needs a paid developer account), so the first time macOS won't open it: click **Done**, then open **System Settings > Privacy & Security**, scroll down to the line about NightShift, click **Open Anyway** and run the installer. It puts NightShift in Applications.

Both include the NightShift plugins, which other music apps can use too: **Lofi** (Cassette, Vinyl, Crush, Haze), **Bass** (Drive, Split) and **Nightshift Drums**.

## Sounds

The studio drum kits, the grand piano and the orchestra are free, and NightShift downloads them the first time you ask for one, from the people who recorded them (DrumGizmo, Salamander Grand Piano, Versilian Studios). The 808 and 909 kits and the synth sounds are built in, so you can start making music straight away.

## Source

NightShift is free software under the GNU GPL v3 or later. Its source is in this repository; the plugins' source is in [nightshift-lofi](https://github.com/ExfilBravo/nightshift-lofi), [nightshift-bass](https://github.com/ExfilBravo/nightshift-bass) and [nightshift-drums](https://github.com/ExfilBravo/nightshift-drums).
